task.notes: Tries K9: fold T3/Gata4rep1->rep2 with the released wild-type series added for the reference's revert.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

raw.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition

raw_did.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw_did.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition
raw_did.did: G = DID_C x ([KO - WT in Mesp1-lineage labels] - [KO - WT in strict non-Mesp1 labels]) from the fold's source knockout alone (gene_factor's unrescaled log ratios); clip(phi_raw x exp(G)) on the reference's Mesp1-lineage cells, phi_raw elsewhere; applied once per class with t3_decompose.apply_gene_factor
